summary.zh: 找出断层的目标、孤岛与冲突的 OKR
summary.en: Trace the strategy cascade and find orphan goals and silos.

description.zh: 把公司战略一路映射到部门、团队和个人目标，找出没有来源的孤立目标、相互冲突的 OKR 和部门各自的局部最优。适合各部门方向不一致、OKR 接不上战略时使用。检查脚本只依赖 Python 标准库。
description.en: Maps the strategy cascade from company goals down to teams and individuals, surfacing orphan goals and conflicting OKRs. Use it when teams pull in different directions. The checker script needs only the Python standard library.
